why: A block only one branch writes, and the server drops. The write waits on `flag/skipped-the-label`, which only `branch/skipped` sets, so the exported path never lays it and no configuration of it was walked; the runtime arm lays every block-writing line, conditional or not, at once. A wall torch facing north hangs on the block south of it, and the cell south of the pedestal holds air in every configuration any write can reach. The build refuses it, naming the torch's cell, the conditional line that writes it and what stands south of it. It declares no unit: which block holds which is the pinned game's rule over blocks an effect already writes, and states no DSL surface.
